name: Image-Generation-Next.js
description: AI Image Generator with Next.js, Powered by OpenAI & Azure

paragraphs: This Next.js single-page web app allows users to generate images based on text prompts, utilizing OpenAI's DALL-E and ChatGPT APIs. The app is built using the powerful Next.js framework and styled with the popular Tailwind CSS utility-first CSS framework. It features serverless API backends powered by Microsoft Azure Function App with HTTP triggers and a Storage Account for saving generated images in a blob container. Deployed on Azure (for the HTTP triggers) and Vercel (for the front-end), this app offers a seamless and modern user experience.
features: Generate images from text prompts using OpenAI's DALL-E
Receive prompt suggestions from OpenAI's ChatGPT
Serverless API backends with Microsoft Azure Function App HTTP triggers
Image storage using Microsoft Azure Storage Account (blob container)
